Impact

Breaking the Policy Silos

The Problem
Governments often operate in silos. For example, before our training & workshops on Aligning Goals, officials from Suriname and Somalia identified "limited coordination" and a lack of "awareness/alignment" between leading institutions as a primary barrier to a realistic national strategy.
The Outcome after our intervention
  • 100% Coordination breakthrough: Every participant surveyed reported that the course helped them identify new, specific points for inter-agency coordination within their government.
  • Understanding of the intersection of petroleum, national development goals, and NDCs shifted from a baseline of "Some" to "High" or "Very High".
  • Participants gave a nearly perfect score when asked if the learning would directly impact their work performance, indicating a high level of practical utility.
